_comment: Timeout settings required for local inference. Merge these two keys into
~/.pi/agent/settings.json.
settings.json is deliberately NOT tracked by the dotfiles repo (see the
home/pi/ rule in .gitignore) because Pi rewrites it constantly. It lives
here as a documented snippet instead.
Both Pi and Raft read this file, because raft-computer's runtime resolves
its agent dir to ~/.pi/agent. So these values cover local Raft agents too.
retry.provider.timeoutMs: 1800000 (30 min)
A cold 128K-token prefill measures ~380s on this machine, and with the
server running two slots an agent can additionally queue behind another
agent's generation. The default aborted queued requests, which is what
surfaced as Raft's 'Model service request failed (custom)' errors.
httpIdleTimeoutMs: 0 (disabled; default is 300000 = 5 min)
This is a header/body idle timeout. A long prefill streams NOTHING until
it finishes, so the 5-minute default can kill valid work mid-prefill.
The provider timeout above remains the backstop, so disabling this does
not mean a hung request waits forever.
Deliberately not set: retry.provider.maxRetries. Pi's docs warn that
raising it lets SDK-level retries intercept out-of-quota errors before Pi
sees them, which can block an agent until the quota resets.
